authority_scope: route generation/freeze only; no candidate is qualified, no receiver is discharged, and no mathematical/Stage32 MAIN credit is granted

route_records.receiver_target: R29-LG2-EFF::ALL_NUMERICAL_SURVIVORS on FM-GEO-S; geometric low-genus effectivity/carrier layer over the exact numerical survivors.
route_records.proposed_new_input: A population-complete effective-cone/fixed-component certificate which, for every numerical-survivor divisor class D, returns either INEFFECTIVE or an exact decomposition D=F+M with F a nonzero forced fixed component and M in a strictly smaller well-founded receiver measure.
route_records.forward_implication: If the certificate is total on R29-LG2-EFF and every descent leaf is either a closed catalogue class or a certified impossible effective class, then R29-LG2-EFF is discharged; any strict certified reduction of unresolved leaves is a nontrivial receiver effect.
route_records.future_falsifiable_unit: Choose one frozen residual row block and test whether the same exact fixed-component predicate is derivable for every class in that block without assuming an actual curve.
route_records.future_success_predicate: A replayable certificate removes at least one previously open effectivity class/block or gives a strictly smaller complete subproblem.
route_records.future_failure_or_block_predicate: No population-preserving effective-cone adapter, no forced component, or no well-founded strict descent measure can be certified.
reverse_scope_firewall: Does not complete the 178-row numerical census.
Does not imply multibranch disposal.
Does not transfer a V6-only fixed-component statement to all receiver rows.
Does not imply Stage32 closure.

route_records.receiver_target: The same geometric effectivity receiver R29-LG2-EFF, attacked through dimensions of low-genus strata rather than cone/fixed-component structure.
route_records.proposed_new_input: For every numerical-survivor class D and target geometric genus g in the frozen receiver, an exact linear-system dimension together with a source-valid lower bound for the codimension of the required equigeneric/singularity stratum determined by the genus defect.
route_records.forward_implication: If the required equigeneric codimension exceeds the complete-linear-system dimension for a class D, then no actual low-genus carrier of that class exists; a population-complete inequality removes the corresponding receiver subset.
route_records.future_falsifiable_unit: On one frozen row block, compute/lock the dimension side and the required genus-defect codimension side and test the strict inequality for the entire block.
route_records.future_success_predicate: At least one exact previously-open row block is excluded from R29-LG2-EFF by a population-wide dimension inequality.
route_records.future_failure_or_block_predicate: The codimension bound is not valid for the singularity types allowed on S, or the dimension inequality never becomes strict on the tested complete block.
reverse_scope_firewall: A dimension count without a theorem controlling the relevant equigeneric stratum is not exclusion.
Does not complete numerical census.
Does not automatically classify multibranch-at-node carriers.
Does not imply Stage32 closure.

route_records.receiver_target: The exact 178 residual unibranch numerical rows, without identifying them with the single g1-d186 O210/Q602 special branch.
route_records.proposed_new_input: A population-wide modular/uniformization invariant for the frozen low-genus unibranch numerical population, with exact finite image and exact preimage map back to the same 178-row manifest.
route_records.forward_implication: If admissible invariant values partition the 178-row population into exact preimages and exclude at least one nonempty preimage or replace a row block by a strictly smaller complete finite decision problem, then the FULL178 numerical blocker is strictly reduced.
route_records.future_falsifiable_unit: Construct the invariant/preimage adapter on one complete frozen row block and verify whether it is informative beyond the current row/orbit labels.
route_records.future_success_predicate: An exact nonempty row/orbit block is removed or population-preservingly reduced by the modular invariant.
route_records.future_failure_or_block_predicate: No population-wide uniformization map exists, the preimage adapter changes the receiver semantics, or the invariant is constant/nonpruning on the complete tested block.
reverse_scope_firewall: Must not reuse O210/Q602 as the definition of all 178 rows.
A modular invariant on g1-d186 alone is not breadth progress.
Does not imply effectivity or actual curve existence.
Does not imply Stage32 closure.

route_records.receiver_target: R29-LG2-EFF as frozen in EX5-01 is a geometric curve/Picard population on S and EX5 adds no Q-rationality restriction.
route_records.proposed_new_input: A pure obstruction to Q-definition/rational descent of a geometric carrier, with no additional geometric nonexistence consequence.
route_records.forward_implication: Rejected at generation: failure of Q-descent alone does not remove a member from the frozen geometric receiver population, so this implication has no receiver effect under the current EX5 semantics.
route_records.future_falsifiable_unit: None for pure Q-descent under the frozen population. Re-entry requires an exact source change showing the receiver itself requires the relevant field-of-definition condition, or a descent theorem with an independent geometric nonexistence consequence.
route_records.future_success_predicate: Not applicable under current frozen receiver semantics.
route_records.future_failure_or_block_predicate: The receiver remains geometric with no Q-rationality requirement.
reverse_scope_firewall: Does not exclude geometric carriers merely because they are not Q-defined.
Does not change Stage32 receiver semantics by adding a rationality condition.
Does not imply Stage32 closure.

route_records.receiver_target: Exactly the 178 residual unibranch numerical rows under the existing FULL178 manifest and completeness semantics.
route_records.proposed_new_input: An exact branch-and-bound/lattice/ILP/SAT reduction that preserves the existing 178-row manifest, partitions each attacked row block exhaustively, and emits replayable terminal certificates for every pruned or completed branch.
route_records.forward_implication: If the complete partition for a row block has only certified terminal leaves, that block is numerically complete; if every 178-row block is so certified, FULL_D176_D192_NUMERICAL_ORBIT_CENSUS can be established subject to the existing Picard-leaf completion contract.
route_records.future_falsifiable_unit: Run the reduction on one complete smallest-cost frozen row block with no artifact-heavy scaling and compare its exhaustive terminal partition to the current blocker.
route_records.future_success_predicate: One complete open numerical row/block obtains a smaller exact search space or terminal certificate with no loss of manifest coverage.
route_records.future_failure_or_block_predicate: The reduction cannot prove completeness, merely samples candidates, or its pruning predicate is not monotone/source-valid on the exact manifest.
reverse_scope_firewall: Finite sample misses are not row exclusion.
Numerical completion is not effectivity.
Does not cover multibranch receiver.
Does not imply Stage32 closure.

route_records.receiver_target: Actual low-genus carrier layer and the separate multibranch-at-surface-node receiver, preserving the distinction from the unibranch numerical cap.
route_records.proposed_new_input: A row-to-local-defect budget giving the required global genus defect and an exhaustive source-valid list of allowed local conductor/delta/intersection contributions at smooth-locus singularities and surface nodes, including branch multiplicities.
route_records.forward_implication: If no allowed local-defect partition realizes the required global genus defect for a receiver subset, that subset has no actual low-genus carrier; if the only partitions violate the multibranch branch data, the corresponding MB subset is excluded.
route_records.future_falsifiable_unit: For one complete frozen class/row block, enumerate the exact local-defect partitions permitted by the ambient model and compare their sums with the required global defect.
route_records.future_success_predicate: At least one previously-open effectivity or multibranch subset is excluded by an exhaustive incompatibility of global defect and allowed local contributions.
route_records.future_failure_or_block_predicate: The allowed local singularity list is incomplete, the global-to-local defect identity is not source-locked for the population, or compatible partitions remain.
reverse_scope_firewall: A V6 local calculation cannot be widened to all rows.
Unibranch degree caps do not discharge MB.
Local incompatibility for one singularity type is not population-wide exclusion.
Does not imply Stage32 closure.
